title: Poison Gas Bomb
body:
Syntax: poison gas bomb <target>

Bukijutsu level 40, 40 Chakra, 15 Stamina, 8-second cooldown (before level-based scaling). Requires a carried Poison Gas Bomb, which is consumed when a toxic trap is attached to the target. After two combat pulses, the trap detonates for 12-23 base damage and inflicts Poisoned unless disabled. This is a one-use item-based technique, separate from the persistent TOXIN BINDING property on a weapon. See HELP POISON and HELP TRAP DISABLING.
